subject: Todd McClearan
text: Todd McClearan is reportedly in the game as a special guest character, according to a rumor the author says Turmell confirmed.

evidence.quote: I talked with Turmell and asked him if Todd McClearan was in the game ... as a special guest character.

subject: NBA Jam Tournament Edition
text: Rumored that NBA Jam Tournament Edition may give a bonus for beating all 27 teams.

evidence.quote: there might actually be a bonus if you beat all 27 teams.

subject: Arcade play cost
text: Arcade play typically costs one to two dollars per complete game, depending on location.

evidence.quote: Look to spend a dollar to two per complete game, depending on location.

subject: Version 2.0 machines
text: Version 2.0 machines can swallow an occasional coin without giving a credit.

evidence.quote: There are some minor bugs in Version 2.0 that regard the machine swallowing up ... an occasional coin and not giving a credit

subject: Version 2.0 machines
text: Version 2.0 machines have the Tank Game killing off players and ending a regular game.

evidence.quote: Tank Game killing off players and ending a regular game, along with correcting

subject: Version 2.0 machines
text: Version 2.0 machines show the wrong jersey color for special guests.

evidence.quote: a jersey color problem with special guests.

subject: Version 3.0 update chips
text: Version 3.0 update chips fix the credit problems, special guest jersey colors, and games ending early at the Tank Game.

evidence.quote: correct the credit problems, fixes the jersey color of special guests and ... prevents games from ending at the Tank Game.

subject: Arcade machine version check
text: After entering the Turmell code, if Turmell appears in a purple Lakers uniform the machine is version 2.0.

evidence.quote: Enter the Turmell code, MJT, March 22nd. If Turmell ... is in a purple color Lakers uniform, you are on a 2.0 machine.

subject: Arcade machine version check
text: After entering the Turmell code, if Turmell wears the jersey color of the team selected the machine is version 3.0.

evidence.quote: If Turmell is in the color jersey of the team you select, such as a red ... jersey for the Bulls, you are on a 3.0 machine.

subject: 2-on-2 complete game
text: In a 2-on-2 complete game the winning two-player team stays on for free to face the next two people or the Computer.

evidence.quote: If you play in a 2-on-2 complete game, usually four to eight dollars, the ... winning two player team gets to stay on for free to face the next two people

subject: Player initials
text: Entering your initials is best for record keeping.

evidence.quote: It is always best to enter your initials for the record keeping.

subject: Player initials
text: Entering initials followed by birth month and birth date lets the computer identify the player and show their record.

evidence.quote: Enter your initials, followed by your birth month and birth date.

subject: Win and loss records
text: Only complete games count toward records; partial games do not.

evidence.quote: Only complete games count in ... records, partials do not.

subject: Sacramento Kings
text: The Sacramento Kings have a good dunker in Spud Webb and a good three point shooter in Tisdale, but they are slow.

evidence.quote: i. e. the Sacramento Kings ... Tisdale, but they are slow.

subject: Golden State
text: Golden State has an excellent three point shooter in Mullin and a fair dunker.

evidence.quote: Golden State has an excellent three point ... shooter with Mullin, and a fair dunker.

subject: Orlando
text: Orlando has a terrific three point shooter in Skiles and a terrific dunker in Shaq, but worse speed than Sacramento.

evidence.quote: Orlando has a terrific three ... shooter (Skiles) and a terriffic dunker (Shaq), but they have worse speed

subject: Charlotte, Chicago, Atlanta
text: The author's opinion is that Charlotte, Chicago, and Atlanta are the three teams with the best balance.

evidence.quote: In my opinion, the three teams with the best balance are ... Charlotte, Chicago, and Atlanta.

subject: Michael Jordan
text: Michael Jordan is not in the game, according to Turmell.

evidence.quote: The official word from Turmell is that Jordan is NOT in the game.

subject: Magic Johnson
text: Magic Johnson is rumored to be in the machine but is not in the game.

evidence.quote: Neither ... is Magic Johnson, who is rumored in the machine also.

subject: Pass
text: Press pass to pass; press turbo and pass to throw a quicker, safer pass.

evidence.quote: TO PASS: Press pass. Press turbo and pass to throw a quicker, safer pass.

subject: Shoot
text: Hold the shoot button down to shoot.

evidence.quote: TO SHOOT: Hold the shoot button down.

subject: Shot accuracy
text: A shot is more accurate when the player is at the peak of the jump.

evidence.quote: Shot is more accurate when player ... is at the peak of the jump.

subject: Head fake
text: Tap the shoot button once to head fake.

evidence.quote: TO HEAD FAKE: Tap shoot button once.

subject: Head fake
text: Computer drones will shoot if the player head fakes while they have the ball.

evidence.quote: Unfortunatly, your Computer drones ... will shoot if you do this while they have the ball.

subject: Dunk
text: Hold shoot while running to dunk; hold turbo and shoot for a super dunk.

evidence.quote: TO DUNK: Hold shoot when running. Hold turbo and shoot for a super dunk.

subject: Layup
text: Hold shoot for a short time while running to lay up.

evidence.quote: TO LAY UP: Hold shoot for a short time when running.

subject: Elbow throw
text: Tap turbo twice, then tap shoot repeatedly, to throw elbows; the head fake also seems to include an elbow throw.

evidence.quote: TO THROW ELBOWS: ... 1) Tap turbo twice. ... 2) Tap shoot repeatedly (head fake seems to include an elbow throw).

subject: Steal
text: Tap steal to knock the ball away.

evidence.quote: 1) Tap steal to knock ball away.

subject: Steal
text: Tap steal and turbo to knock the opponent down.

evidence.quote: 2) Tap steal and turbo to knock OPPONENT down.

subject: Block
text: Hold shoot to jump to block; hold turbo and jump to jump higher.

evidence.quote: TO BLOCK: Hold shoot button to jump. Hold turbo and jump to jump higher.

subject: Rebound
text: Rebounding is automatic when the player is close enough; otherwise press shoot and point toward the ball.

evidence.quote: TO REBOUND: This is automatic if you're close enough; otherwise press shoot ... and point toward the ball.

subject: Alley oop
text: Alley oop is easier with two-player teams: the player without the ball moves under the basket and holds shoot to jump, while the ball handler presses turbo and pass to throw quickly.

evidence.quote: TO ALLEY OOP: Easier to do with two player teams. ... moves under the basket and holds shoot (to jump). ... presses turbo and pass to throw to the jumping player quickly.
